description: This file contains auxiliary plotting functions for a data visualization project using Bokeh, pandas, numpy, and astropy. It provides functions to add regression lines, hover tools, limit boxes, scatter plots, line plots, and layout customization to plots, specifically tailored to plotting data from a database with time-based information, and includes domain-specific processing like polynomial regression and time conversion.

methods.name: pol_regression(x, y, rank)
methods.description: Calculates polynomial regression of specified rank for given x and y data arrays.

methods.name: add_hover_tool(p, rend)
methods.description: Appends a hover tool to a Bokeh plot with specified tooltips and renderer.

methods.name: add_limit_box(p, lower, upper, alpha=0.1, color="green")
methods.description: Adds a translucent colored box between lower and upper bounds on a Bokeh plot.

methods.name: add_to_plot(p, legend, mnemonic, start, end, conn, y_axis="default", color="red", err='n')
methods.description: Adds scatter and line plots with regression to a Bokeh figure, including optional error bars, for a specified time range from a database.

methods.name: add_to_wplot(p, legend, mnemonic, start, end, conn, nominal, color="red")
methods.description: Adds line and scatter plots for wheel position data from a database to a Bokeh figure.

methods.name: add_basic_layout(p)
methods.description: Applies basic styling and layout to a Bokeh plot.

ctags.name: add_to_plot
ctags.pattern: /^def add_to_plot(p, legend, mnemonic, start, end, conn, y_axis="default", color="red", err='n'):$/
ctags.signature: (p, legend, mnemonic, start, end, conn, y_axis="default", color="red", err='n')

ctags.pattern: /^def add_to_wplot(p, legend, mnemonic, start, end, conn, nominal, color="red"):$/
